The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Having given up on life, 15-year-old Chise Hatori sells herself at an underground auction, where she is bought by Elias Ainsworth, a not-quite-human mage, for 5 million pounds. She learns that he intends for her to be his future bride, and her world begins to change.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Few people know the truth about the bookstore on the outskirts of London that Elias frequents. He takes Chise there, where they meet Angelica, who teaches Chise a little bit of magic, but... The true power of the Sleigh Beggy materializes a fragment of Chise's memories.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Simon, who is assigned by the Church to keep an eye on Elias, visits with some business. One of his requests brings Chise and Elias to the ends of the earth, where they meet Elias' mentor, Lindel, along with an old race on the verge of extinction. An old one, about to return to the earth, spends his last moments sharing a dream with Chise.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Long ago, the humans and cats of Ulthar, city of cats, were struck by a great tragedy. For generations, the souls of those who were at the center of this tragedy have been sealed away by the king of cats. Chise and Elias travel to Ulthar in order to complete Simon's second task: to purify the spirits that remain.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: To sorcerer Refnred's eyes, Chise is a sad girl, being duped by a mage. But no matter what Elias' true motives are, Chise has no intention of leaving him. Elias was the first person to value her, after all. As she walks towards the epicenter, she learns of the truth behind it. The sight of a boy appears behind the tragedy.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Chise is deep in thought as she watches the souls return to where they'd belonged all along. More than ten days have passed since the incident at Ulthar, but she is still in a deep sleep. Elias and Simon stand worriedly by her side, when they are met by two unexpected guests: Titania, Queen of Fairies, Lord of Tír na nÓg.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The dog, with its flowing, black hair and burning red eyes, called Chise by the name "Isabelle." The Church's final request is to investigate a black dog that emerged in a cemetetry, but the black dog ends up saving Chise from danger. Meanwhile, Renfred's apprentice, Alice, is also on the move, looking for the black dog.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Alice sees Elias' changes and decides immediately that he could never be human. Sorcerer Cartaphilius, who is attempting to capture the black dog by manipulating Renfred and Alice, causes Elias to show a completely different side of himself when his "work" hurts Chise. Those who know Elias call him the Pilum Murialis.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: With the church's requests fulfilled, things were supposed to go back to normal. But Elias has been acting strange since the last request: he'd vanished on the first morning after Chise had spent a night in his room. Neither Angelica's kind words nor Ruth's pure words are enough to put Chise's mind to rest.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Chise and Selkie climb aboard a dragon's back to meet Lindel, to have her own mage's staff made. Frustrated by Chise's acceptance of her being kept as a pet by Elias, he describes the time he found Elias in the darkness. Meanwhile, Elias, who had stayed at home by himself, receives a letter from a sorcerer's college.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Elias, is an odd failure who pretends to be human -- but is it because of his master's words, or because of his distrust for humans, that he stopped communicating about himself? Lindel's alias, Echoes, refers to the to a song akin to the sound of snowmelt, traveling through the wind, causing the blooming of flowers and the dancing of fairies. The magic of the song turns into a mirror the surface of the water Chise peers into. What does she see beyond the mirror?

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Lindel finishes the staff that Chise had finished carving. As she finishes, she meets an old friend, who offers her some wise advice.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Chise and Elias are in the middle of shearing Wooly Bugs, magical creatures who eat cold from the air and grow wool with magical properties. Chise becomes distracted and is attacked. As Chise recovers, she and Elias open themselves up to each other more.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: With Chise being transformed into a fox, she takes off running into the woods. Elias chases after her. Later, Chise is visited by the Leanan sídhe, who is attached to Joel, claiming that Joel will not wake up.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: With King Oberon taking Chise into the Fairy realm for recovery, Silke becomes agitated waiting at home. Chise slowly recovers under Dr. Shanon's care, a fairy that was raised as a human.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Christmas is coming up. Alice invites Chise out to London, where they hang out together and go gift shopping for Renfred and Elias.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Stella, a young girl Chise encountered while Christmas shopping, finds that her brother, Ethan, has gone missing and her parents have forgotten he exists.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Stella visits Chise with her payment of sweets. Elias, irritated by and jealous of Stella, runs away. Chise finds him hiding in a shadow but becomes worried as he restrains her and seems to want to eat her.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: In the land of dragons two young dragons are kidnapped from Lindel by Cartaphilius. Chise awakens from a dark dream to find, Alice, Renfred, Adolf and college administrator Tory Innis in Elias’ home. They explain Cartaphilius stole the two dragons using a teleportation device he stole from Renfred and want Elias to find the dragons and take them home

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: As the dragon rampages, Elias tells Chise they must absorb the dragon’s magic in order to stop it. This leaves Chise in a predicament as Elias becomes unable to help.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Elias and Chise attend Mariel’s coven meeting and meet Phyllis, Mariel’s high priestess. Secretly, Elias is given information that could help Chise. Following the meeting, Chise becomes suspicious of Elias' activities.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Having captured Chise, Cartaphilus begins grafting parts of her onto himself. He forces her to relive some of her worst memories.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Elias earns the help of many, and they form a search party for Chise. Meanwhile, Chise and Cartaphilus relive his past together.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Cartaphilus and Chise argue over their respective approaches to dealing with their own suffering, beating each other up brutally in the process.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Chise attends her first day at the College with Elias in tow.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: It's a day of new beginnings at the College as Chise attends her first day of classes and meets some of her fellow students, and Elias adopts a mysterious guise for his first time teaching as a visiting instructor.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Chise shares a meal with her new classmates, but several teachers and students at the College have their eyes on both her and Elias for reasons yet unknown. Chise and Elias head home for the weekend and Stella drops by for a visit.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Two separate conversations reveal the multitude of revelations that Chise and Elias have had about one another, and the ways they've both grown and changed. Hazel guides them on a dangerous shortcut back to the College.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Chise learns a bit more about the history of both the College and her classmates. Zoe's secret is revealed, and a pact is formed.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Alice and Chise to try and sort through their feelings on their complicated relationships with their respective masters.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Chise attends P.E. as Elias looks on. Philomela is summoned home. Alice stubbornly continues her training, while Adolf consoles Renfred through his troubles. The students embark on a camping trip.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: An otherwise educational and relaxing camping trip with her classmates ends with a terrifying encounter in the shadows of the night forest, forcing Chise to rely on her own wits and abilities instead of Elias' magic.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: After returning from camp, Lucy is still unconscious and it's still not clear what's behind her sudden loss of strength...this worries Chise deeply.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: While watching over Lucy, Chise discovers her connection to Seth and their family's tragic history. While a professor seems to have been the victim of a user of a banned book, a mysterious killer seems to resurface...

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Apparently, a forbidden magic book called "The Testament of Carnamagos" is being used to rob Lucy and Simeon of their magical powers. But who exactly is behind it is still unclear. Elias takes care of the matter because he fears that otherwise Chise will put herself in danger for her friend and because he himself wants to protect a friend.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: It's time for family explanations, whether between Lucy and her brother, or Alice and Renfred. The College is also going through a complicated period where other magicians seem to want to harm new students.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The College is sealed off to protect the students and staff from whatever or whoever has been sapping magic from victims. Zaccheroni puts the students' survival abilities to the test, but with a catch: no sorcery allowed.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Outside the College, the witches hunt for the missing book. Inside, the students try to juggle lessons with their own personal goals and relationships. Philomela confides in Alcyone, but an ominous message reminds her of her assignment.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Bored with having nothing to do but study, the students play a puzzle game, but it stirs up bad memories for Philomela and Rian. Alcyone ponders her assigned role. As the rainy season starts, Elias and Chise finally sit down to catch up.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Violet and Chise host an after hours test of courage for their classmates by having them pair up to visit various haunted locations around campus, but the evening leads to some revealing conversations.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The mystery deepens as all the students drained of magic suddenly wake up feeling fine. Rumors about the culprit start to rise among the student body. Veronica checks in on Philomela.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Despite their disappointment that the College will be closed through Christmas, the students try and prepare for the holiday party. Chise takes another dive into Lucy's memories. Philomela reaches her breaking point.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Philomela bargains for Liza to undo the seal over the College so she can return home to fulfill her duty. As Chise gives chase, her power gives her a terrifying new form.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Alycone reflects on Philomela's childhood and her all-important task. An ancient and fearsome goddess blocks Chise's path on the way to the Sargant family home and demands tribute that was promised a year ago.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: While Zoe fights off the werewolf, the other students finally reach Philomela. Chise takes a dive into her dark memories, but as everyone's secrets begin to unravel, Philomela hesitates to take her classmates' outstretched hands.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: As Lizbeth's plans near fruition, Philomela thinks about what it is she really wants.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: The fight begins in earnest as Lizbeth starts to gain the upper hand, but Chise and company receive some unexpected assistance.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Magus’ Bride Hindi Season 2 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Philomela stands against Lizbeth in a final battle of wills.
